title: pilosella densiflora subsp. radiocauloides
intro: Pilosella densiflora subsp. radiocauloides, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup or Pyrenean Buttercup, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a possible treatment for various conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella densiflora subsp. radiocauloides include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
